predictions.articleTitle: Kolding IF vs Aalborg Tactical Breakdown & Preview: Depleted Visitors Face Second-Half Surge
predictions.coreRecommendation: Support Kolding IF to avoid defeat (Home Win / Draw) with Both Teams To Score (Yes) as the balanced convergence around a 1:1 or 2:1 script.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw captures Kolding IF's 71.4% home unbeaten record and Aalborg's seven-match winless slide alongside visiting backline absences (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Both Teams To Score: Yes aligns with Kolding's 78.6% BTTS rate and Aalborg's 100% away scoring record across seven road trips (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)

Under 2.5 Goals reflects the 2.61 total lambda baseline, high big-chance waste (71.0% vs 60.0%), and mutual midfield/forward absences anchoring a 1:1 primary outcome (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Kolding's second-half home surge tests injury-hit Aalborg's fragile lead protection.

spf.comment: Retains both the 1:1 stalemate and 2:1 home victory scripts because Aalborg's 100% away scoring floor prevents excluding the draw while their defensive absences undermine an away-win call.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.61 combined lambda (51.6% Poisson Under 2.5), elevated big-chance waste on both sides, and Aalborg's consecutive 1:1 draws.

btts.comment: Driven by Kolding IF's 7.1% clean-sheet rate against an Aalborg attack that scored in all seven away games, paired with Aalborg's depleted backline.

score.comment: 1:1 is the clear 12.5% Poisson mode matching recent draws and August's H2H, while 2:1 reflects Kolding's one-goal home winning pattern.

goals.comment: Poisson distribution peaks at 2 goals (25.0%) and 3 goals (21.8%), aligning cleanly with the 1:1 primary and 2:1 secondary projections.

bqc.comment: Kolding IF draw 57.1% of home first halves and score 60.0% of home goals after the break, pointing to a level interval before either a 1:1 draw or 2:1 home breakthrough.
